title: WhatsApp had 55 employees when Facebook paid $19 billion
summary: On February 19, 2014 Facebook announced a $19 billion deal for WhatsApp: $4 billion in cash, $12 billion in stock and $3 billion in stock units for employees. WhatsApp had over 450 million monthly users and, per Forbes, 55 employees.

beats.say: WhatsApp had fifty five employees when Facebook paid nineteen billion dollars.
Facebook announced the deal on February nineteenth, twenty fourteen.
Four billion dollars was cash and twelve billion was Facebook stock.
Another three billion was stock units granted to WhatsApp employees.
beats.cap: Plus $3B in stock units for staff

beats.say: More than four hundred fifty million people used it every month.
About seventy percent of them were active on a given day.
It was free to download, then cost ninety nine cents a year.
More than a million new people registered every day.
A team of fifty five served hundreds of millions of people.
The price tag was nineteen billion dollars.
